follow-up time: Until completion of pregnancy or last follow-up
exposure: Timing of COVID-19 infection in pregnancy
cohort: 14,264 pregnant and recently pregnant people who were tested for or clinically diagnosed with COVID-19 during pregnancy and did not report a pregnancy loss before 20 gestational weeks
finding: Severe COVID-19 infection after 20 weeks gestation significantly increased the risk of preterm delivery, primarily due to an increase in medically indicated preterm deliveries, while mild or moderate COVID-19 conferred minimal risk.
